item.title: #USkToulouse2026 Symposium Online Program is Out! - Urban Sketchers
item.description: The 14th Urban Sketchers International Symposium - Toulouse 2026 Online Program is now live! This is where you’ll find the full overview of this year’s Symposium programming, bringing together workshops, activities/demos, and lectures, along with detailed session descriptions and faculty info.Whether you’re planning your days, getting to know the instructors and presenters, or exploring the range of learning opportunities on offer, the Online Program is your guide to the Symposium experience.
